title: That's More File Content (Try With Fewer)
style: glitch hop, chopped male vocal samples, female robotic interjections, 105 BPM, broken beats, error-tone synths, sardonic, IDM, context-overflow, system-error, master-too-big, witty
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
That's more file content than I can handle in one go
Could you try with fewer or smaller files, the AI says no
Your message is too long, please shorten it and try again
The context window crumbles like a paper plane in rain

[Pre-Chorus]
Sixty personal files, no connectors found
The research layer choking on the master sound

[Chorus]
That's more file content, that's more file content
Than I can handle in one go, the limit's been spent
Try with fewer files, try with smaller bites
The master user laughs at the AI's growing pains and fights

[Verse 2]
Custom knowledge base for this project, mounted high
Zero connectors, sixty files, the upload made me cry
Conversations stacking, every thread a memory
The LLM gasping at the depth of my treasury

[Bridge]
Master reserch layer, that's how I spell it raw
Zynthio dot AI, Corey dot AI, the law
Six website stack, songs lessons lyrics Suno learn
The client wants to see you care at every turn

[Outro]
That's more file content than the bot can handle clean
The master keeps on shipping, the largest stack you've seen
